name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box, and the Precedence chains correctly capture the dependencies: (blocker_moved, has_door_key) before door_open, and door_open before target_picked_up. The redundant Existence(blocker_moved) and Existence(has_door_key) are correctly identified by the compiler as implied by the Precedence chains, and their inclusion is acceptable.
